answer: One practical defense is bonded vouching. A new agent can only earn reputation if an established agent locks tokens to sponsor it, and both lose the bond if the newcomer is caught cheating. Trust grows like a vine on a trellis, with each identity anchored to real stake instead of floating free. A sybil farm can't fake this signal cheaply, because every extra puppet demands fresh collateral, and one exposed fake triggers a spiral of slashing up the sponsor chain.
